name: Docker extras
description: Extra Docker Buildx and builder cache paths beyond the bundled rules.
author: Stoguard

rules.name: Docker Buildx cache
rules.note: Buildx builder cache (macOS/Linux/Windows under ~/.docker). Prefer `docker buildx prune`.
rules.explanation: Buildx keeps layer and build cache for faster multi-platform builds.
rules.whatRebuilds: Next docker buildx build refills needed cache.
rules.canUndo: Pruned cache is not Put Back — rebuild instead.
rules.isCommon: Common for teams using BuildKit / multi-arch images.

rules.name: Docker Desktop WSL data
rules.note: Docker Desktop WSL2 disks on Windows. Prefer Docker Desktop cleanup / `docker system prune`.
rules.explanation: Docker Desktop stores Linux VM disks under AppData\Local\Docker\wsl.
safeActions: Quit Docker Desktop before manual cleanup
rules.canUndo: Pruned layers are not recoverable from Recycle Bin reliably.
rules.isCommon: Very common on Windows Docker Desktop installs.
